construction.cc_tests: 551_Cap_1C (starts at rest) and the discharge step of 549_C20DisCh (from its preceding rest): z0 = 1 on Q_HPPC, v_p0 = 0 after the protocol rest; each profile is truncated where z first falls below 0.10 (declared scoring end)
construction.hold: BACKWARD (the current at sample k flowed over [t_(k-1), t_k]); forward hold is a sensitivity only
construction.ocv: FIXED, not fitted: the last sample of the first rest and of every rest >= 3000 s in the HPPC record, as (z, V) knots, linear between; the window and test SOC ranges must lie inside the knot range
construction.pulse_initial_state: z from the coulomb count; v_p0 = 0 with basis: >= 590 s rest after the preceding charge pulse or >= 3000 s after an SOC step; screen: the measured voltage moves by <= 1 mV over the pre-pulse rest, otherwise the window is excluded
construction.pulse_window: the rest step immediately before a discharge pulse step (~10 s), the pulse step (~10 s) and the rest step after it (~40 s), ending before the charge pulse; 0.1 s sampling
construction.rest_band_basis: the published current accuracy: a |current| within it is not distinguishable from rest
construction.sign: Forge current = -Current (Digatron reports discharge as negative)
construction.soc: z = 1 at the first HPPC sample, minus the net integrated charge over Q_HPPC = the net charge delivered by the whole HPPC record (100 % to the tester's 0 %); the same Q for every test

data.cell: ONE new 3 Ah LG HG2 18650 cell (readme: 'A brand new 3Ah LG HG2 cell'); serial in the CSV header
data.dataset: LG 18650HG2 Li-ion Battery Data (Kollmeyer, Vidal, Naguib, Skells), McMaster University
data.identity_check: every file's sha256 equals the sha256 Mendeley publishes for it (MENDELEY_MANIFEST.json of branch claude/domain-real-data, read from the Mendeley public API)
data.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Mendeley public API); cite the DOI

measurement_uncertainty.charge_counter: UNKNOWN (never read: charge is integrated from the measured current)
measurement_uncertainty.current: +/-75 mA (0.1 % of the 75 A full scale), uniform -> 43.3 mA standard
measurement_uncertainty.source: dataset readme: 'Digatron Firing Circuits Universal Battery Tester channel with a voltage and current accuracy of 0.1% of full scale'; 'AD592 +/-1degC accuracy'
measurement_uncertainty.status: DECLARED_TYPE_B (publisher's instrument statement; no calibration certificate)
measurement_uncertainty.voltage: +/-5 mV (0.1 % of the 5 V full scale), uniform -> 2.89 mV standard

data.reader: benchmarks/battery_1rc_identifiability/lghg2.py: bytes in; a Prog Time written twice is one sample when V and I agree within the published accuracy (else the file is refused)
data.temperature: 25 degC ambient block only; the model has no temperature dependence

excluded_with_reason.549_Dis_0p5C, 549_Dis_2C: both files start 60 s into the load step (first Step Time 60 s): the initial polarization is not evidenced
excluded_with_reason.HPPC windows below SOC 0.10: outside the declared applicability (strong low-SOC resistance dependence)
excluded_with_reason.drive cycles (UDDS, HWFET, LA92, US06, M: they contain regenerative CHARGE current; the 1RC route is discharge/rest only and refuses charge; adding charge physics is out of scope until evidence shows the need
excluded_with_reason.truncated pulses: a discharge pulse step shorter than 9.5 s, or whose median current differs from the nearest commanded level (3, 6, 12, 18 A) by more than 1 %, was stopped by the tester

frozen_before: any parameter fit and any held-out comparison on these data

identifiability.decision: IDENTIFIABLE if R0, R1 and C1 are each identified; WEAKLY_IDENTIFIABLE if tau or R0 is but R1 or C1 is not; NOT_IDENTIFIABLE otherwise
diagnostics: profiles of the objective in log R0, log R1, log C1 and log tau (others re-optimized)
window-block bootstrap of the calibration windows (B = 200, seed 0)
v_p0 sensitivity: -(preceding charge current) x R1 x exp(-590 s / tau)
identifiability.parameter_identified_if: profile rise >= 10 % within a factor of 3 on both sides, AND bootstrap CV <= 0.25, AND not on a bound, AND the hold-convention shift <= 10 %

models.1rc: OCV table (fixed) + R0 + R1 + C1 (engcore thevenin_route)
models.bounds_basis: R0, R1 within 0.05-10x the 20 mOhm impedance in the cell header; C1 spans tau from 1e-4 s to 2e5 s: wide, physical-sign bounds only
models.objective: sum of squared voltage residuals over every scored calibration sample
models.optimizer: scipy least_squares (trf) in log-parameters; 8 fixed starts
models.parameter_set_max_current: 18 A commanded maximum plus the 0.075 A current accuracy
models.parameter_set_temperature_range: calibration case-temperature min and max, each widened by the 1 degC sensor accuracy (declared now, from the published accuracy)

nasa_closure_preserved: benchmarks/battery_1rc_closure is not modified and not re-evaluated

outcome_mapping.IDENTIFIABILITY_SUPPORTED: IDENTIFIABLE, and a held-out set is NOT_ASSESSABLE
outcome_mapping.MODEL_REJECTED: IDENTIFIABLE and a held-out set FAILS for the 1RC
outcome_mapping.MODEL_VALIDATION_SUPPORTED: IDENTIFIABLE and every held-out set PASSES for the 1RC
outcome_mapping.ledger_rule: an outcome is a report, not a promotion. calibration may PASS only on IDENTIFIABLE; independent_validation stays MISSING with one cell (no cross-cell transfer); measurement_uq is decided by review of the Type B evidence, not by this script

roles.calibration: HPPC discharge-pulse windows of the 3 A (1C) and 18 A (6C) pulses at every SOC level >= 0.10
roles.descriptive_only: the 0.9 A SOC-step windows with their 1 h relaxation (a slower time scale than one RC fitted to pulses can represent; reported, never accepted)
roles.heldout_cc: 551_Cap_1C and the C/20 discharge, separate tests on later or different days
roles.heldout_pulses: HPPC discharge-pulse windows of the 6 A (2C) and 12 A (4C) pulses at the same levels (current interpolation inside the calibrated range)
roles.independence: ONE cell: every comparison is within-cell; no cross-cell transfer is tested

acceptance.applicability: a set holding any window or test the route judges outside its validated domain cannot PASS (NOT_ASSESSABLE)
acceptance.basis: pulse windows: 3x / 6x the published 5 mV voltage accuracy; constant-current tests include OCV-table interpolation and slow diffusion, so 5x / 10x. The earlier Gate A limits (50 / 90 mV) are reported for continuity

validation.comparison: paired bootstrap over windows (B = 2000, seed 0) of RMSE_Rint - RMSE_1RC: 1RC_BETTER if the 95 % interval is above 0, RINT_BETTER if below, NOT_DISTINGUISHED otherwise; one cell
validation.predictions: 1RC through thevenin_route.run_thevenin_1rc; Rint through the production kernel on loaded intervals and V = OCV(z) at rest (the kernel refuses I = 0)
